text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh. Looks like you got plenty of 
rest."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
In that case, that's a relief... Yeah. You 
do have a tendency to push yourself a bit 
too hard, after all...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
...Ahem. Let us get down to business. I 
performed maintenance on the ST-2 while 
you were away.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
With this, training should be more 
efficient than usual. ——Expect great 
things.
